120	practical way to divide it so that everyone would be satisfied. Each one understands that in the division of
121	the Holy Land, as it's called, there is
122	something in it. There is a
123	divine matter in it, a spiritual matter. It's a matter that touches each
124	person in his soul.
125	The division is not only a division of land, where the Jewish people
126	each received his portion. It is in fact
127	the division of the mission of each one. Each tribe had
128	its own special mission, each family its
129	special mission, and each and every one has
130	this special mission. And this is the wonderful message:
131	HaShem did this wondrous miracle
132	to give us the picture
133	of how we will know what our mission is and how we will behave
134	and live with our mission.
135	But let's first lay down a introduction.
136	We know that no two people are the same. Just as
137	their faces are not alike, their opinions are not alike.
138	Their character traits are not equal, their fingerprints are not
139	equal, our fingerprints, which are one centimeter,
140	and let's see something wonderful: in that one centimeter
141	how many possibilities there can be. There were no two people, and there never will be, among the billions upon billions of
142	people who exist and who have existed,
143	who have
144	two identical fingerprints. A wonder of wonders.
145	And so it is very important that each one of us
146	be aware of his special qualities.
147	He needs to know the gift that HaShem gave him. And I
148	know there are people who, out of humility, say "I have nothing,
149	no, no, no, no, that is not right, it's the opposite."
150	The moment you are not aware of the gifts, it is ingratitude.
151	HaShem gave you the gifts. HaShem gave you a good
152	mind. A good heart, sensitivity,
153	a sense
154	of helping another, a sense of prayer, whatever it is, and you
155	don't thank HaShem. This has nothing to do with
156	pride, since it is not you who made it. Don't take
157	credit for it.
158	It is not a credit for you. It obligates you
159	to act. HaShem gave you the strength, you need
160	to use it.
161	There is a saying I heard in the name of the Baal Shem Tov, I haven't seen
162	it, that he says: what is Gehinnom?
163	Gehinnom is a state where a person goes after 120 years
164	to heaven
165	and sees what he could have been, what he could
166	have done, the enormous potential he had,
167	and suddenly he feels: I wasted it, I threw it
168	in the trash. That is the greatest Gehinnom. And therefore each one
169	must be aware, must have the perception,
170	the grasp, of what my qualities are. I think that once
171	I told this, about the Rebbe Rashab, a relative of the Rebbe,
172	the Rebbe Rashab. Once there was a farbrengen and he spoke words of
173	immense wisdom, and then someone said to him: Rashab, you are
174	so deep, so wise, did you ever make a mistake
175	in your life? He says: yes. In what did you make a mistake? He says:
176	in my qualities. I say to him: you have many
177	qualities, don't be humble, you have many qualities. He says:
178	no, no, you didn't understand me well. I didn't mean
179	that I made a mistake by thinking I have many qualities
180	and I don't. The opposite. I thought I had fewer, and I have
181	more. The Rebbe Rashab said to his son, this is the way of
182	Chassidut: know your qualities, but know that it
183	obligates you. And this is what is written: Yaakov saw a ladder
184	set on the earth with its top reaching heaven. And behold, angels of
185	Elokim ascending and descending on it.
186	The commentators ask: it should have been the opposite. Behold,
187	angels of Elokim descending, they are in heaven
188	and afterwards ascending. What is the meaning of ascending and descending?
189	So the Midrash says: they went up above to high levels
190	and they saw that the image of Yaakov is engraved
191	on the Throne of Glory.
192	They descend below and see him sleeping.
193	The ministering angels wanted to harm Yaakov.
194	They see him as he could be,
195	and they look here, and with their own eyes they did not see
196	his greatness. So how do you miss such
197	potential, such an enormous potential that HaShem gave him?
198	That is to say, each one must be aware,
199	aware of what you can be, of your potential.
200	And this is not the time to be humble: I have nothing, I'm
201	not successful, I can't. The opposite. "And his heart was lifted
202	in the ways of HaShem": be aware of this and thank
203	HaShem. There is a verse: "Honor HaShem
204	with your wealth,"
205	from what He graciously gave you.
206	You need to honor HaShem, to use
207	what He graciously granted you, what He gave you.
208	So the Midrash says: He gave you a son, make him a Brit
209	Milah. He gave you a house, put up the mezuzah. He gave you
210	a courtyard, build a sukkah.
211	The Midrash says: if you had a pleasant voice,
212	stand and say Shema Yisrael in a loud voice and be
213	a chazan.
214	You need to honor HaShem with your wealth. What is "your wealth"?
215	What He graciously gave you. Everyone must think about
216	his qualities. And not only that: if he doesn't know,
217	ask your good friend. Ask about your qualities.
218	
219	And with us, we have
220	a yeshivah of young men,
221	and many times I gather them and I say: each
222	one should write three or five qualities about his friend.
223	When you tell him "write about yourself" he is embarrassed,
224	so write about your friend. And afterwards each one gives
225	the letter to his neighbor, and people open up so much, they
226	receive so much strength and power.
227	The Gemara comes and says, the Midrash of Reish Lakish: the world was not
228	worthy of using gold. Why is gold needed in the world? One needs
229	food, one needs water. Why is gold needed? Why was it created?
230	For the Mishkan, or it is written, for the Beit HaMikdash.
231	The Rebbe says something wonderful:
232	gold is a luxury. You don't need
233	it in order to live.
234	There are things a person needs
235	in the world in order to live: intellect, heart, health, and so on
236	and so on. But every person must think: what do I have
237	that is a luxury? Gold is a luxury.
238	What do I have that is above the average,
239	above what a person needs in order to live?
